parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is made of durable plastic, forming the upper portion that is pressed down to drive staples.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal mechanism that pushes staples through paper when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around a hinge at the rear, moving downward to apply pressure and staple papers together.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a plastic cover that encloses the staple magazine and provides a surface for pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal staple track and provides a smooth surface for the user to press when stapling.
parts.Movement_description: It moves together with the body during operation, pivoting around the hinge.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the lower metallic part of the stapler that provides stability and supports the stapling mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the anvil plate where staples are bent and secures the stapler on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the foundation for the stapler’s moving parts.
